item.description:
Welcome to the TimeCal beta

TimeCal checks for updates daily and installs them in place; you can check manually any time via File > Check for Updates… The beta is invite-only: the app asks for your code once and remembers it.

New in 0.1.2

  • Private-beta invite gate. The app is freely downloadable but unlocks with a personal invite code.
  • Smarter wide-zoom labels. Day labels now degrade gracefully (every day → every other day → week starts), and weekend boundaries draw a subtle vertical edge line.
  • Window behavior. Closing the window keeps TimeCal running in the Dock, and pinned event cards stay on your desktop on their own. The title bar shows the version.
  • Panel polish. Bookmarks and Library open one at a time with a clean hand-off animation.
  • Fixes. Hover cards cap long titles at two lines and always enclose their content; mouse-wheel zoom is much faster; Help menu now opens the Guide and a feedback email.

Feedback

Send anything, bugs, ideas, confusion, to evan@sandpipermediagroup.com.
